stanza: a small bedroom of a poor old house in a remote mountain village, present day, with the roller blinds shut and only a small bedside lamp giving weak yellow light: plain painted walls with a few damp stains and nothing hanging on them; a double bed with a dark wooden headboard, two pillows both dented, and a crumpled white sheet; a small nightstand with the lamp and a small framed photograph; on the floor next to the bed, a plastic bucket and a big bottle of bleach; a wooden wardrobe; a window with closed plastic roller blinds.
persone: One person: the young widow in her early thirties sits on the edge of the double bed facing the viewer, in a black jumper and a long black skirt: tall, slim and healthy, with very pale smooth skin, a long oval face, very big dark eyes set wide apart, thin high eyebrows, a small full mouth and long straight black hair falling to her waist; her long-fingered hands, red and chapped, are clasped in her lap; around her neck, on a piece of string, hangs a man's gold wedding ring. She has been hiding in here for days: scared but defiant, staring at the viewer.
pose: the young widow sitting on the edge of the double bed with her hands in her lap
